scope: Independent local log replays and state-machine tests; GitHub and messenger calls are stand-ins. No existing test suite was run.

findings.trigger: One GitHub shell step pulls two images. The first succeeds, and the second ends with unexpected EOF.
findings.cause: The full script preamble sets one pulling flag; the first success clears it, and the second command is not echoed again during execution.
findings.impact: A real image download failure receives no infrastructure retry and can be sent to a worker as a code failure.
last_lines: E   AssertionError: the second image download must receive its retry

findings.trigger: A valid Compose setup command uses shell backslash continuations and its download ends with unexpected EOF.
findings.cause: Each physical log line is tokenized independently, so the trailing backslash raises ValueError and no pull context is established.
findings.impact: A real Compose setup download failure receives no infrastructure retry and can be sent to a worker as a code failure.
last_lines: E   AssertionError: shell continuation must preserve the setup command

findings.trigger: Compose up --build runs a Dockerfile RUN command whose application build raises RuntimeError: unexpected EOF.
findings.cause: Setup context also covers BuildKit RUN output, and a matching substring is treated as image download evidence without checking the build phase.
findings.impact: A Dockerfile code failure is retried as infrastructure; matching repeats can then retain the handoff indefinitely as a cache problem.
last_lines: E   AssertionError: a Dockerfile command failure must not be blamed on the runner

survived: All four required download forms and supported setup command variants, with later failing-test annotations
Application output and recovered pulls followed by failing tests
Missing runner evidence, shell syntax in logs, diagnostic redaction, and runner line-break rejection
One retry, same-runner repeat, changed job/runner/error, partial recovery, private file modes, and sent receipts
A held merge lock, two concurrent calls with the first request held, an in-progress partial rerun, an ambiguous timeout, a budget pause, and malformed claim files
Missing or timed-out logs and ineligible runner labels
Busy daytime wake, failed-send recovery, missing orchestrator, and co-delivery with a lost check
choices: Treat ordinary multiline shell commands, sequential image pulls, and Compose builds as reachable uses. No production code, model text, product behavior, or pull-request branch was changed.
